title: Horizontal pasting of canonical derived base-change maps
statement: Assume derived module categories on every scheme [def-pc-derived-category]. Let j:A→X, f:X→S, j′:A′→X′, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X and v:A′→A satisfy g′≫f=f′≫g and v≫j=j′≫g′. For every E in D(O_A), the canonical base-change maps [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] obey BC(f,f′,g,g′)(Rj E)≫Rf′(BC(j,j′,g′,v)(E))≫relativeMVImageComp(j′,f′).hom at Lv E = Lg(relativeMVImageComp(j,f).hom at E)≫BC(j≫f,j′≫f′,g,v)(E), with relativeMVImageComp as defined in [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. No square need be cartesian and no arrow need be an open immersion.

proof.text: Transpose under the adjunction for j′≫f′, transporting it to the composite j′ and f′ adjunction by the right-adjoint uniqueness equation defining relativeMVImageComp. Expand both inner base-change maps as counit transposes. Naturality moves the inner transpose through the f′ counit; the triangle identity cancels the inserted unit. The two counits become the composite counit for j≫f. Transport the source through its uniqueness comparison. Associativity of the pinned derived pullback comparisons, applied to j′,f′,g and v,j,f, identifies the resulting square comparison with the outer base-change comparison; the two commutativity equations identify the equality transports, and proof irrelevance identifies their proofs. Injectivity of the composite Hom equivalence proves the displayed equality. Identity arrows, empty schemes and zero E require no exclusions. This is the scheme specialization of horizontal composition of mates, including the canonical composition comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeDerivedBaseChange_horizontal
    {A X S A' X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : A ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S) (j' : A' ⟶ X') (f' : X' ⟶ S')
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (v : A' ⟶ A)
    (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) (hj : v ≫ j = j' ≫ g')
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory A) :
    schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' h ((schemeDerivedDirectImage j).obj E) ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map
          (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap j j' g' v hj E) ≫
        (relativeMVImageComp j' f').hom.app ((derivedPullback v).obj E) =
      (derivedPullback g).map ((relativeMVImageComp j f).hom.app E) ≫
        schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (j ≫ f) (j' ≫ f') g v
          (by rw [← Category.assoc, hj, Category.assoc, h, ← Category.assoc]) E
